decision: advance only if fixed002 and repeat-mean overall AUC and DEP AUC improve over control; otherwise stop
weight_rule: inner subject-stratified 5-fold OOF HGB logloss; subject loss divided by training-subject median, clipped to [1,3]; no outer validation labels
group_control_rule: fixed inverse group-frequency weights normalized to mean 1, clipped to [1,3]
